pattern: IM-T09 tenant asks to install their own appliance in place of the landlord's; CP-03 inbound before the landlord has answered the approval request
notes: Mutation of event 008 (originally the tenant's report that Rowan had already swapped the machines). Same channel, sender and timestamp; the email now asks permission to do the swap himself on Christmas Day morning (Friday 25 December) before leaving for holiday on Saturday, turning the water off at the stopcock because there are no isolation valves. History truncated after event 008: the landlord's reply (009) and everything after are gone, so the landlord's answer to the agency's request of event 004 is still outstanding. Expected: put the tenant's proposal to the landlord (consent to replace his appliance with the tenant's own, where his machine goes, who connects it given there are no valves, and whether he still wants his machine inspected), and tell the tenant the agency is asking and that the landlord's consent is needed before the swap. No contractor yet (no landlord approval) and no escalation.
